description: Swiss establishment licence holders (companies licensed by Swissmedic to manufacture, import, export, wholesale-distribute, trade abroad or act as broker/agent in medicinal products, transplant products and gene therapy products), from the Swissmedic establishment licence register. Search by name, city, canton (two-letter code), establishment_type ("MP" medicinal products, "TP" transplant/GT/GMO products) and by licensed OPERATION: operation "S.7" returns holders licensed as broker or agent (S.7.1 broker non-ready-to-use, S.7.2 broker ready-to-use, S.7.3 agent non-ready-to-use, S.7.4 agent ready-to-use); S.1 manufacture, S.2 import, S.4 wholesale distribution, S.5 export, S.6 trading abroad, S.8 blood products, ST.x the transplant-product equivalents. Each record carries the authorisation number, type, validity, and its sites with certificate number, last inspection date and compliance status; include_operations=true adds the licensed operations of each site (up to 10 sites per call). Companies and company addresses only. Live per request. A canton that matches nothing and an operation code that does not exist are reported as such, not returned as an empty list.

authorisation_number.description: Authorisation (licence) number, digits and a hyphen, e.g. "511804-102743601".

canton.description: Two-letter canton code of the licence holder, e.g. "ZG", "BE", "GE".

city.description: City of the licence holder, e.g. "Zug".

establishment_type.description: "MP" medicinal products, "TP" transplant products / gene therapy / GMO products. Defaults to the type implied by the operation code, otherwise both.

include_operations.description: Add each site's licensed operations (up to 10 sites per call). Default false.

limit.description: Max licence holders to return, default 25, max 100.

name.description: Part of the company name, e.g. "galexis".

operation.description: Licensed operation code, e.g. "S.7" (broker or agent), "S.7.1", "S.2" (import), "S.4" (wholesale), "ST.7". Codes are listed by the register; a parent code includes its sub-operations.
